description: Runs the same gross pay through 2 to 10 states (or DC) and ranks them by annual take-home pay for tax year 2025 or 2026, showing state income tax, the method for each state (exact 2026 schedule for CA, NY, NJ, IL, PA, GA, NC; labeled estimate elsewhere; no wage income tax in AK, FL, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WY) and how far each trails the best. Federal tax and FICA use the IRS 2025/2026 tables and wage base. Use it for relocation and remote-work offers.

filing_status.description: Federal filing status. Qualifying surviving spouse uses married_filing_jointly.

gross_annual.description: Gross annual pay in USD before any deduction. Give this OR gross_per_period.

gross_per_period.description: Gross pay for one pay period in USD. Multiplied by the periods in pay_frequency.

hsa_annual.description: HSA contribution through payroll (cafeteria plan) for the year in USD. Lowers income tax, Social Security and Medicare.

pay_frequency.description: Pay frequency: weekly (52), biweekly (26, default), semimonthly (24), monthly (12), quarterly (4) or annual (1).

pretax_401k_annual.description: Traditional (pre-tax) 401(k) deferral for the year in USD. Lowers income tax, not FICA. Leave out for Roth.

pretax_401k_percent.description: Traditional 401(k) deferral as a percent of gross (e.g. 6). Use instead of pretax_401k_annual.

items.description: US state or DC: two-letter code (CA), name (California) or slug (new-york).

name: compare_states_take_home
title: Compare take-home pay across states
